title: ACS Modifications
description: Modifications applied when decision is 'modify'. Two mutually exclusive shapes: wholesale leaf-text replacement via 'modified_content', or structured edits via 'redactions' and/or 'parameter_overrides'. The two shapes never combine, and structured edits MUST target disjoint paths so the effective payload is order-independent (Specification 6.3). At postCompact, a MODIFY replacing summary.value sets Guardian-supplied provenance on summary.provenance (origin: 'system', trust: 'trusted', source_id naming the Guardian or policy rule); the provenance of values introduced by 'parameter_overrides' at other hooks is not defined in v0.1.

modified_content.description: Wholesale replacement string for the hook payload's single primary text leaf: summary.value at postCompact, content[0].value on a single-text-part userMessage or agentResponse, the trigger text at agentTrigger, or outputs[0].value on a single-output toolCallResult (Specification 6.3). Structured object or multi-part payload edits MUST use 'redactions' and/or 'parameter_overrides'. Exclusive: MUST NOT be combined with 'redactions' or 'parameter_overrides', which have no path to address inside an opaque replacement.

redactions.description: Targeted redactions applied to specific fields. Each path MUST be disjoint from every 'parameter_overrides' target (Specification 6.3).

parameter_overrides.description: Replacement values for tool call arguments, keyed by argument name. Each target MUST be disjoint from every 'redactions' path (Specification 6.3).

oneOf.title: Structured edits: redactions and/or parameter_overrides on disjoint targets, never modified_content.
